test_coverage_notes: The code itself does not include tests. Typical test coverage would be in files like 'test/IPAddressV4_test.cpp' or similar in the test suite. Tests should cover: (1) private address detection (10.x.x.x, 172.16.x.x-172.31.x.x, 192.168.x.x, loopback), (2) public address detection (addresses outside private/multicast), (3) multicast detection, (4) class determination (A, B, C, D, etc.). Gaps may exist if edge cases (e.g., broadcast, reserved ranges, or malformed addresses) are not tested. If AddressV4 is constructed from untrusted input, fuzzing or negative tests are important but may not be present.
